_comment: Static credit-weight calendar for the sportsbook odds pacer. Weights are multipliers on a day's baseline share of the month's credits; the dynamic events count refines within these. Dates are UTC calendar days of the GAME; the pacer shifts each entry back 3-7 days to find the pull window. Season ranges are inclusive. Verified items cite a source; items marked verify=true are from general knowledge and must be confirmed before shipping.

weekly_profile._comment: Pull-day weights for games on each weekday, already shifted into the 72-168h window. Row = sport, key = pull weekday (Mon..Sun), value = relative weight.

No football. Soccer + NHL only; MLS sprint and Liga MX help. Spend ~50% of a fall day, bank nothing (credits reset monthly) so use spare on 2 feeds per run.
FIFA window. NHL + MLB (if it opens Mar 24) only.
